status: Recorded before computing these new comparison outputs; retrospective extension after seeing the earlier 99 us results, not preregistered or newly blind

windows.reason: 0.75 s of within-acquisition past for all predictors; sparse fixed grid limits computation, unchanged 99 us event definition

history_features: each qubit non-G fraction in preceding 33,333,3333,33333 samples
each qubit non-G fraction in each of 15 preceding 16666-sample segments
each qubit log1p samples since last non-G, capped at 250000
phase_features: sine and cosine of deposited phase; causal availability unverified
scores: paired differences in each contiguous 50-acquisition validation block
policy: For each predictor, accept scores no greater than the 15th percentile of eligible training scores. Apply that fixed threshold to validation; report coverage and event counts without IID intervals.

window_generative_models.conditioning: 36 deposited phase bins crossed with 4 past-10-ms pooled non-G activity bins, edges 0.01,0.05,0.2
window_generative_models.marks: 0=no persistent excursion; otherwise first qualifying start falls in samples 1-11,12-22,23-31, crossed with total non-G future samples below 12 or at least 12
models: two-state shared latent environment, independent local marks given latent state
independent local marks plus diagonal common-event component
window_generative_models.smoothing: Each conditioning cell receives 100 pseudo-observations distributed as the global training joint-mark table with Jeffreys 0.5 per category. Models fit this same retained smoothed table.
window_generative_models.fitting: EM, 300 iterations, three fixed deterministic initializations for shared environment; training objective chooses initialization; no validation tuning
held_out_structure: paired events with first onset in same 33-us bin
both qubits spend at least 36 us classified non-G within the future window
window_generative_models.scope: Normalized generative laws for observed finite-window marks. Not full physical trace models, intrinsic transitions, or identification of microscopic coupling.

intervention_audit: Check common calibrated projected-quadrature threshold u>0.5 at 1 ms using Fig2 off/on and Fig6 shock records; verify common G/E references and notebook normalizations. Do not downsample continuous traces or claim causal transfer from clock equality.
